prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 3:4 cinematic studio portrait of an adult man with neatly styled dark hair, a short beard, black sunglasses, and a calm soft smile. He wears a black-dark-blue button-up shirt and stands with arms crossed beside a dark textured pillar. Use a near-black background with restrained negative space. Light him with a blue rim from camera left, a red rim from camera right, and a soft neutral key to create controlled color separation around his hair and shirt. Shoot on a Sony A7R V with an 85mm lens at f/2.8, preserving natural skin texture, crisp fabric detail, and a polished professional mood. No text, logo, or watermark.
